evals.prompt: 幫我用 TypeScript 串接 Oen Payment 建立一個結帳頁面，金額 1500 元，訂單編號 ORD-2024-001，成功跳轉到 https://myshop.com/success，失敗跳轉到 https://myshop.com/fail
evals.expected_output: TypeScript code that POSTs to /checkout with correct merchantId, amount, currency, orderId, successUrl, failureUrl, and constructs the redirect URL from the response
expectations: Code calls POST to payment-api.oen.tw/checkout or payment-api.testing.oen.tw/checkout
Request body includes merchantId, amount (1500), currency (TWD), orderId, successUrl, failureUrl
Authorization header uses Bearer token pattern
Constructs checkout redirect URL from response data.id
Includes error handling for the API response

evals.prompt: Oen Payment 的 webhook 回傳 T0001 錯誤碼，這是什麼意思？我的交易金額是 500 元
evals.expected_output: Explanation that T0001 means transaction failed, and the hint that amount < 100 triggers failure in testing environment. Since 500 > 100 it should succeed in testing, so investigate other causes.
expectations: Correctly identifies T0001 as 'Transaction failed' (交易失敗)
Does NOT incorrectly claim 500 < 100 is the issue

evals.prompt: I need to create a monthly subscription checkout with Oen Payment. Amount is $300 TWD, 12 months total, order ID SUB-001. Give me the cURL command for the testing environment.
evals.expected_output: cURL command that POSTs to payment-api.testing.oen.tw/checkout-subscription with amount, currency, orderId, numberOfPeriods=12, and the redirect URL pattern
expectations: Shows the subscription checkout redirect URL pattern after the API call
